- Organize and import brush flow seeds; currently only QB is supported
- When adding MP tags, it is recommended to use them in conjunction with the 'Monitor Default Downloader' option in MP

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2

npx cap open ios
```

SuperGness/codey.body:
# Codey

Codey is an enhancement launcher for the Codex desktop client, centrally managing model routes, accounts, sessions, and extensions, and providing usage analytics and task notifications.

## Key Features

- Routes and Models: Manage official and third-party routes, configure proxies, sync available models for accounts, drag to adjust route and model order, switch models and thinking intensity in tasks; when local routing is enabled, exhausted official quota will not prevent switching to third-party routes.
- Official Accounts: Manage multiple ChatGPT accounts, customize gateway addresses, view quota and reset time separately, and switch between accounts in the same conversation.
- Requests and Usage: Query request latency, tokens and errors, analyze usage trends, model proportion and cost estimation.
- Session Management: View task status, import and export sessions, delete specific turns and restore backups.
- Extension Management: Manage MCP, Skill and trusted Codey plugins, support configuration, enable/disable, import/export and plugin log viewing and cleaning.
- Plugin Routes: Support filling keys in routes, or binding saved accounts by configured email through transfer plugins; when disabled, only retain regular routes with filled keys.
- Task Count: Plugins can query the number of running and failed tasks on demand.
- Page Enhancement: Improve plugin marketplace and common session operations, support offline recovery of selected plugins.
- Desktop Operations: Read application state and perform clicks, input, and scrolling through optional Codey Computer Use plugin.
- Prompt Optimization: One-click optimization of input content, results can be further edited.
- Model Division of Labor: Assign models to sub-agent roles, session naming, message submission and other auxiliary tasks.
- File Tools: Optionally enable FastCtx to read, search files and batch replace content.
- Task Notifications: Receive completion, failure and intervention-waiting notifications through Feishu, WeChat Work, Telegram, ntfy or WeChat ClawBot.
- Diagnostics and Updates: Check and fix configuration, recover disconnections, clean diagnostic logs, provide pet optimization, rendering diagnostics and automatic update checks.
- Release Management: System settings can view and copy device ID, independent Cloudflare console can manage versions, changelogs, devices, full releases, whitelist gradual rollout, targeted releases and historical full rollback.

## Usage and Precautions

Opening Codey will automatically start Codex. Click the Codey button at the bottom of the icon bar on the left to enter the console; whether restart is needed depends on the interface prompt.

- Only supports clearly identifiable Codex desktop client; launching may restart the selected client, please end running tasks first, and make clear selection when multiple versions coexist.
- Official routes require adding official accounts; the default account determines the client login identity, each route uses its own account.
- After enabling local routing, you can set context budget for official and third-party models, but cannot expand service provider capacity; third-party capabilities and cross-route session compatibility depend on the service provider and Codex version.
- Quota and fees are estimates and do not represent actual deductions or official limits.
- Installation packages and native plugins should only be from trusted sources; native plugins have the same system permissions as Codey, Codey does not modify the client security switch, if integration fails it will attempt native startup after confirmed cleanup.

TAKETODAY/today-infrastructure.body:
# TODAY Infrastructure

A Java library for applications software infrastructure.

## Overview

This project originated in 2017. It is primarily a Java library for building high-performance Web applications and general applications.

## Main Purpose

Primarily for learning technology, and also to provide a basic framework for my blog website https://taketoday.cn (the blog website was actually built to learn and practice technology). The blog is also open-sourced: https://github.com/TAKETODAY/today-blog

<details>
  <summary>Click to view background</summary>

## Background

Originated during university while learning programming. Later, I built a blog website using Java Servlet. During development, I found there was a lot of repeated code, and I felt such code was inelegant. Although I had just started learning programming, when I was studying [Struts2](https://struts.apache.org/), I tried to write a similar program that eliminated a large amount of repetitive code through `XML` configuration. Thus the first-generation [infra-web](https://gitee.com/I-TAKE-TODAY/today-web/tree/v1.1.1/) was born and open-sourced.

Later, after learning `Java annotations`, I implemented an annotation-configured version [today-web annotation version](https://gitee.com/I-TAKE-TODAY/today-web/tree/2.1.x/)

When [today-web annotation version](https://gitee.com/I-TAKE-TODAY/today-web/tree/2.1.x/) just came out, I was also learning `Spring`. Without an `IoC` container, it felt inconvenient. I saw many people online writing their own Mini Spring and such, so I boldly decided to `write one myself`. I had this determination because I had already written today-web, so writing an IoC shouldn't be that hard, right? At first, I referred to various mini-spring implementations. To be honest, in retrospect, it was precisely because I referred to their code at that time that I had some cognitive misunderstandings. It wasn't until June-December 2021 that I deeply studied the Spring source code to correct them. It turns out that writing such a thing is indeed not difficult, but to make it elegant requires some expertise. I believe my code is still elegant. Don't believe me? [Welcome to my Bilibili live stream](https://live.bilibili.com/22702726). (I started live-streaming writing this library in 2021, but later work got busy so I didn't stream much. I'll stream again when I have time).

When I first started writing (probably around 2018, I also checked the Git commit history haha), I was quite at a loss, so I referred to the various `Mini Spring` mentioned above. Thus began another round of learning. ...

# 🪪 Hong Kong Immigration Department Appointment Quota Monitoring

Real-time tracking of Hong Kong Immigration Department **ID card replacement** appointment quotas, with automatic notifications sent to **Feishu groups + Feishu private chat** when new quotas are released.

---

## 📱 Method 1: Join Feishu Groups (Recommended)

The bot automatically pushes quota changes, **messages arrive instantly**, join the group and use immediately, no configuration needed.

> 📖 **[Group Information & How to Join](https://scn7uo58gnuo.feishu.cn/wiki/QSFlwcMBmil7sGkZRBTcAWqwnCf)** (Multiple group plan, auto-redirect when group is full)

### 💬 Method 2: Feishu Private Chat Subscription

If you don't want to join a group, you can also **filter by date**, receiving notifications only for the dates you care about:

1. [Private message the bot 'HKID Release Auto-Detection'](https://applink.feishu.cn/T98uc8RbxI8c) (Send any message to trigger)
2. The bot will reply with an interactive card, supporting:
   - 📅 **Subscribe to specific dates** — Only track the date you've booked
   - 🔔 **Subscribe to all dates** — Notifications for all releases
   - 📊 **View / Modify / Cancel Subscriptions**
3. You can also reply with dates directly for one-click subscription, for example `08/15, 08/20-08/25`

Supports three filtering modes:
- 📅 **By Date** — View only specific dates, any office
- 🏢 **By Office** — View only specific offices, any date
- 🎯 **By Date + Office** — Exact match

> 💡 The bot's private chat has a 1-2 second delay; if you're in a hurry, joining a group is recommended.

---

## 🖥 Dashboard

> 🖥 **[quota-monitor Dashboard](https://Zheyi-D.github.io/quota-monitor)**

- 📊 Real-time view of appointment quota status across all offices in Hong Kong
- 📈 Release pattern heatmap, visualize release frequency across time periods
- 📖 Includes phone reservation tutorial
- 🔧 Built-in admin panel, supporting subscriber management, statistical overview, dual-channel broadcasting

---

## 📨 Notification Flow

When new quotas are detected, notifications are sent in this order:

> **Group broadcast** (multiple groups in parallel) → **Private DM** (in parallel, only sent to subscribers matching the date)

Feishu group and private chat arrive almost simultaneously.

---

## 🔒 Privacy & Security

- Feishu user data is stored with **AES-256-GCM encryption**, unreadable in the repository
- Only reads quota data **publicly released** by the Immigration Department
- ⚠️ Disclaimer: This system is a third-party open-source tool, not an official service of the Hong Kong Immigration Department. Please refer to the official website for accurate information.

dm20-consortium/dm20.body:
# DM2.0 Platform

---

## Overview

The Dynamic Map 2.0 Platform (DM2.0 Platform) is an open-source information and communication platform for information linkage connecting vehicles, roadside units, and clouds.

It was developed as foundational software for realizing advanced mobility services including infrastructure-cooperative autonomous driving.
It provides integrated search and retrieval functions across dynamic information (target information, signal information, free space information, etc.) and static information (3D high-precision road maps, etc.), handles different communication methods such as ITS radio and cellular networks, and allows them to be used individually or simultaneously.

## Features

* Architecture/Design
  * Designed with reference to [ETSI EN 302 665 V1.1.1 (2010-09)](https://www.etsi.org/deliver/etsi_en/302600_302699/302665/01.01.01_60/en_302665v010101p.pdf), which is the corresponding standard to ISO21217:2010 of the International Organization for Standardization
  * Equipped with a stream-type database for sensor data processing, supports SQL-based [query language](https://www.nces.i.nagoya-u.ac.jp/admobi-dm2/images/dm2_query_language_specification_20260327.pdf)
  * Implemented in C++, supports Ubuntu 20.04 / 22.04 / 24.04 as operating systems
* Communication Methods/Security
  * Supports 5G/LTE cellular networks and 760MHz band ITS radio equipment, can be used individually or together (designed to support LTE-V2X and NR-V2X in future versions)
  * Adopts DTLS (Datagram Transport Layer Security) for network and transport layer communications to achieve both real-time performance and encryption (QUIC support is planned in future version updates)
  * Provides security mechanisms using Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)

esrrhs/fakefish.description: Demo game for verifying FakeLua capabilities: Big Fish Eat Small Fish coin ball
esrrhs/fakefish.body:
# FakeFish

A **demo game** for verifying [esrrhs/fakelua](https://github.com/esrrhs/fakelua) capabilities: Connects FakeLua's script runtime, `runtime.tick` event pump, WebSocket, HTTP, MySQL, JSON, timers, and configuration parsing capabilities in a real playable scenario.

Gameplay is a simple web-based 2D PVP: **Coin Ball · Big Fish Eat Small Fish**. The server is a single-threaded FakeLua program with all gameplay logic in the backend; the frontend only handles presentation and input reporting. Account data is stored in MySQL, and the client communicates with the server via WebSocket.

> This repository is a demonstration and capability verification project, not a complete game product intended for commercial operation.

---

## Design Document

### 1. One-line gameplay

After logging in, players control a 'coin ball' moving in a shared 2D arena. The more coins, the larger the ball; when colliding, the larger ball eats the smaller ball, taking all the opponent's current coins, and the smaller ball respawns at a random position with initial coins/size.

### 2. Goals and Non-goals

| Goals | Non-goals (not in this phase) |
|------|----------------------------|
| Verify FakeLua end-to-end capabilities with a playable demo | Commercial operation, complete content ecosystem |
| Lightweight PVP sandbox with login/registration | Leaderboards, guilds, shops, skins |
| Authoritative server: movement, collision, eating, coin settlement | Client prediction, interpolated physics authority |
| MySQL persistent account and coin storage | Multi-process/multi-threaded sharding, cross-server |
| Playable in a single HTML/JS page | Complex UI frameworks, mobile apps |
| Startup via configuration file (including MySQL, etc.) | Hot updates, operations backend |

### 3. Architecture Overview

```
┌─────────────┐   HTTP(static)    ┌──────────────────────────────┐
│  Browser    │ ───────────────► │  FakeFish Server (single-    │
│  frontend   │   WebSocket JSON │  threaded)                   │
│  index.html │ ◄─────────────── │  FakeLua + net/http/mysql    │
│  + canvas   │                  │  Config → main loop          │
└─────────────┘                  │  runtime.tick()              │
                                 └──────────────┬───────────────┘
                                                │ async mysql
                                                ▼…
```

linesoft2/TaskMonitor.body:
# TaskMonitor

**Chinese** | English (TODO)

Monitor system load in real time from the process dimension.

## Installation & Usage

Recommended for use on Windows 11. This project is distributed as a single-file EXE that can be downloaded directly from the release page.

Download: [CNB (China-friendly)](https://cnb.cool/linesoft2/TaskMonitor/-/releases) | [GitHub](https://github.com/linesoft2/TaskMonitor/releases)

After downloading and opening, you can see a persistent taskbar window on the left or right side of the **system taskbar** (depending on your taskbar settings). Click on any item to view its details and the high-load processes of that item.

## Development Background

When a program performs high-load tasks or the system becomes sluggish, we often need to check the system load and locate which specific program/process is executing the high-load task. TaskMonitor was born from this need. It not only resides in the taskbar to display real-time load across five dimensions, but also allows viewing details of each item and the load of each process when clicked.

## Features

- Single file, near-native rendering performance, extremely low resource usage.
- Only depends on modern Windows built-in .NET Framework, no third-party runtime installation required.
- Fluent2 (WinUI) design style, close to native system UI, modern and beautiful interface.
- Consistent sampling methods and calculation logic with Windows Task Manager, ensuring accuracy.
- Supports integration with Clash/Mihomo, can collect per-process network speed data after proxying.
- Pure Win32 API implementation, no drivers or kernel-level collection methods like Ring0, does not affect system stability.
- Completely free, non-profit, open source.

## Capabilities

- CPU: Supports collection and display of CPU utilization, speed, process count, thread count, handle count, runtime, and per-process utilization.
- Memory: Supports collection and display of memory usage rate, memory usage details, committed memory, cached memory, paged pool, non-paged pool, and per-process memory usage.
- Disk: Supports separate collection per physical disk, supports collection and display of disk usage rate, disk name, disk type, utilization, read/write speed, response time, and per-process read/write speed.
- GPU: Supports separate collection for multiple GPUs, supports collection and display of GPU usage rate, GPU name, utilization, temperature, load type, VRAM usage, and per-process load type and utilization.
- Network: Supports separate collection per network adapter, supports collection and display of real-time adapter speed, network type, SSID, WiFi standard, negotiated speed, local IPv4, public IPv4/IPv6, local latency, public latency, and per-process real-time network speed; supports integration with Clash/Mihomo to display proxied real-time speed in the process list.

metasequoiaime/msime.body:
# Metasequoia IME

Metasequoia IME (MSIME) is a multi-platform Chinese input method for Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, Windows, and HarmonyOS. The six platforms each have their own native input method hosts, all connected to the same shared input runtime and the same React settings interface; the React management interface calls ordinary Rust business libraries through Tauri; the input algorithm is provided by msime-engine.

Project homepage: [msime.app](https://msime.app/) · [GitHub repository](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime) · [Contributors](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime/graphs/contributors) · [Issue feedback](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime/issues)

## Star History

> **About the name**: MSIME is an abbreviation for Metasequoia IME (Metasequoia Input Method), and is unrelated to Microsoft IME and has no association with Microsoft. The code, package names, and repository name `msime` uniformly refer to this meaning. The `shuangpin_profile: microsoft` in settings is the "Microsoft Shuangpin" scheme, one of four key layout schemes alongside Xiaoheng, Ziran, and Shou Dao, available for users accustomed to this layout, and similarly does not represent any association.

**An input method can see everything you type, so this question should have an answer that can be verified line by line: [What data leaves the device](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime/blob/HEAD/PRIVACY.md).** Short version: Under default configuration, only cloud predictions will send the currently-composed pinyin (to Google Input Tools, can be disabled), and all other online features require you to fill in your own credentials to work. Additionally, there is proprietary telemetry that does not carry input content: macOS, iOS, Android, Linux, HarmonyOS send an installation count once at startup to `api.msime.app`, and except for HarmonyOS, will also send exception information on crash, enabled by default with no current toggle; on Windows the same telemetry is disabled by default and will only be sent after enabling "Anonymous usage statistics" in the settings page "About" — the fields, per-platform differences, and storage locations are listed line by line in [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/metasequoiaime/msime/blob/HEAD/PRIVACY.md#安装与崩溃上报). The repository does not integrate any third-party statistics or crash reporting SDKs.

## Module Boundaries

- `crates/client-core`: Host-agnostic client business logic — local configuration, fixed resource generational installation, accounts and sessions, cloud and AI, skins, dictionaries, clipboard, voice, translation, typing statistics; does not depend on Tauri, UI, or platform hosts.

You open the Obsidian community plugin marketplace and are faced with **over five thousand** English-named plugins——`dataview`, `templater-obsidian`, `obsidian-linter`…… names you can't understand, descriptions you can't finish reading, and Chinese users looking for a "mind map" plugin need to spend half an hour translating.

Chinese Market turns this around completely: **search in Chinese, view in Chinese, install smoothly**. It is an Obsidian community plugin search and translation tool built specifically for Chinese users——not just another shell of an English marketplace, but a real tool that breaks down the "language barrier."
